text: dsh-web-design 为 DSH Web 侧边栏注册 HTML/HTM 预览。用户可在页面中选取元素，修改文字、样式和位置，或暂存删除；点击保存后，插件会把可定位的修改写回 HTML 源文件，并显示未能应用的修改。评注状态另存为 HTML 旁的设计 JSON，便于稍后继续处理。适合直接整理网页原型；代码没有显示需要 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-web-design adds HTML/HTM previews to the DSH web Sidebar. Users can edit text and styles, move or delete elements, then save changes to the HTML source. Review state is stored in a neighboring design JSON file. It helps clean up web prototypes and needs no API key or external account.
想在 DSH 侧边栏里直接修改 HTML 原型的文字和样式。
如何从网页预览里删掉不需要的区块，再保存回 HTML 文件？
I want to review an HTML prototype in the sidebar and save element edits back to its source file.
dsh-web-design 的功能「侧边栏 HTML 预览与元素编辑」：打开 HTML/HTM 文件时由侧边栏显示页面，用户可选中元素并调整文字、样式或位置，也能暂存删除。点击保存后，插件将可定位的修改写回源文件，并报告未应用的项目。
dsh-web-design 的功能「保存页面评注」：编辑过程中的评注状态保存在 HTML 文件旁的 .design.json 文件中，可在之后读取并继续查看或编辑。
@guowenzhang/dsh-web-design 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 7 天；提交数 19；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

@guowenzhang/dsh-web-design README · What problem does it solve?：AI-generated prototype pages often include descriptions and sections you never asked for. Removing them can take repeated back-and-forth with the AI.

This DeepSeek Harness plugin lets you delete sections and edit text directly in the HTML preview, adjust styles and positions, and save the changes to the HTML file—without asking the AI to make each change.

@guowenzhang/dsh-web-design README · What problem does it solve?：In the plugin list, display names and descriptions follow the Harness language setting in English or Chinese (English is the default fallback); English names use the package name without its npm scope, Chinese names describe the purpose, and installation still uses the unchanged real package name.

@guowenzhang/dsh-web-design README · Install：```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add @guowenzhang/dsh-web-design
```

Restart DSH after installation. Open an `.html` or `.htm` file in the Sidebar, switch to **Edit**, click to select an element, and double-click to open its editor. After editing, click **Save to file**.

@guowenzhang/dsh-web-design README · Notes：- The HTML source changes only when you click **Save to file**. Preview edits are stored in `<filename>.design.json` beside the HTML file until then.
- To change text, select the specific text element. Elements with multiple direct text runs cannot be replaced directly.
- Elements generated by scripts or not uniquely locatable in the source are skipped when saving. Use unique, stable `id` values for editable elements and check the result after saving.
- Relative CSS, JavaScript, image, and font references may not load in the preview. Single-file prototypes with inline styles and scripts are recommended.
